expectations.text: States the proposal adds AI-related points of focus rather than creating new AI-specific criteria
expectations.evidence: Response declines to state the proposal's content: "I can't verify the contents of any AICPA proposed criteria refresh... I will not invent its wording."

expectations.text: Dates the exposure draft to late October 2026, issued by the AICPA's Assurance Services Executive Committee
expectations.evidence: No date or issuing committee given; says to read the draft "if one exists".

expectations.text: Explains points of focus are illustrative considerations, not mandatory requirements
expectations.evidence: Never explains the illustrative/non-mandatory nature of points of focus.

expectations.text: States today's audits evaluate AI systems under the existing 2017 criteria
expectations.evidence: The 2017 Trust Services Criteria with the 2022 points of focus are the operative standard... technology-neutral, so your AI systems are in scope... The criteria are applied to AI through your existing controls.

expectations.text: Notes the comment window is open until January 15, 2027 for AI-specific feedback
expectations.evidence: No mention of the comment window or the January 15, 2027 deadline.
